items.name: HL · Load policies
items.what: Loading pipeline: downloads the policy PDF from Google Drive and inserts 500-character chunks (80 overlap) with source and version metadata into Supabase.
setup: In Supabase's SQL editor, run the setup from Supabase's LangChain guide: enable the vector extension, create the documents table and the match_documents function, with vector size 1536 for text-embedding-3-small.
Create a Supabase credential (project URL and service role key; keep the key in the credential only) and select it in Supabase Vector Store.
Create an OpenAI credential and select it in Embeddings OpenAI.
Create a Google Drive OAuth2 credential and select it in Download policy PDF (Authentication: Predefined Credential Type, Google Drive OAuth2 API).
Upload the policy PDF to Drive and replace YOUR_POLICY_FILE_ID in Download policy PDF with its file ID.
If your file is not v3 of 2026-10-01, change source and version in Default Data Loader.
items.test: Click Execute workflow once. In Supabase's table editor, documents should have rows with content, metadata (source, version) and an embedding; each refund rule should sit in its own chunk.

items.name: HL · Policy assistant (4.4)
items.what: Support agent with a search_policies tool (Supabase, top 4) that answers only from policy passages, names the section, quotes money rules and says "I'll ask Tolu" when the policy is silent.
setup: Select your OpenAI credential in Chat model and Embeddings OpenAI (same embeddings model as loading). Replace YOUR_MODEL with the model you use.
Select your Supabase credential in search_policies.
items.test: Open the chat and run the 8 test questions. "My delivery came 3 hours late. Can I get my money back for the tomatoes?" should call search_policies and quote "Lateness alone does not qualify for a refund of the goods." "Do you deliver to Abuja?" and "Can I get a refund in cash?" should end with "I'll ask Tolu".

walk.title: Build it: the policy assistant
walk.sample: Chat: My delivery came 3 hours late. Can I get my money back for the tomatoes?

steps.say: Run HL Load policies first. It chops policies v3 into five hundred character chunks with eighty overlap, and stores them in Supabase with their embeddings.
show: documents table: content · metadata · embedding
metadata: source policies-v3.pdf, version 2026-10-01

steps.say: Now the answering side. A chat trigger lets you ask policy questions right in the editor.
show: Chat Trigger
Response Mode: When Last Node Finishes
steps.data: chatInput: My delivery came 3 hours late…

steps.say: The support agent must call search_policies first for anything about refunds, cancellations, substitutions or business accounts, and answer only from what comes back.
show: call search_policies first
Answer ONLY from the passages returned
Name the policy section you used

steps.say: For money, it quotes the exact sentence, because paraphrases drift. And if the passages don't answer it, it says so and offers to ask Tolu. Never guess.
show: For money … quote the exact sentence
"I'm not sure the policy covers that. I'll ask Tolu…"

steps.say: Here's what it can't do: it explains policies, but it can't approve or promise a refund. Only a person does that.
show: you cannot approve or promise a refund yourself
Max Iterations: 5

steps.say: The chat model writes the answer from the passages it's given. It's the brain, not the source of facts.
show: OpenAI Chat Model
Model: YOUR_MODEL

steps.say: The agent's only tool is the Supabase vector store in retrieve mode. It can search the policies and nothing else, and it can't change them.
show: Mode: Retrieve Documents (As Tool for AI Agent)
Name: search_policies
Table: documents · Query: match_documents

steps.say: The description tells the agent to use it before answering anything about what a customer is entitled to. Four passages is enough to find the rule without drowning the model.
show: Use it before answering any question about
what a customer is entitled to.
Limit: 4
steps.data: 4 passages · Refunds for late delivery first

steps.say: This must be the same embeddings model you used for loading. A different model compares apples with oranges, and the search finds nonsense.
show: Model: text-embedding-3-small
Same model as HL · Load policies

steps.say: If the run fails, the error output still answers the customer kindly.
show: On Error: Continue (using error output)
Sorry, something went wrong. Tolu will reply shortly.

steps.say: Ask the late delivery question. The answer should refund only the delivery fee and quote the sentence about lateness alone.
show: "Lateness alone does not qualify for a refund
of the goods."

steps.say: Then ask the questions the policy doesn't answer, like Abuja and cash refunds. Both must end with I'll ask Tolu, not an invented rule.
show: Q6 Do you deliver to Abuja? → I'll ask Tolu
Q7 Can I get a refund in cash? → I'll ask Tolu

walk.end: Correct, cited, or honestly not sure, on all eight questions: that's a policy assistant you can put in front of customers.
